title: Escaping the Agreement Trap: Defensibility Signals for Evaluating Rule-Governed AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through four independent triangulation channels (analyzing the large-scale gap between agreement-based and policy-grounded metrics, independent human validation of defensibility classifications, normative underspecification experiments varying rule detail, and probabilistic signal convergent validity) to ensure the LLM-as-a-judge is measuring objective rule-grounded validity rather than exhibiting a systemic preference for its own outputs or subjective intents.
